conditions.representation: number CDF8,signed symmetric J,real orthogonal U
conditions.initialization: same original qualified J/U at eta=0;NOT saved49-call diagnostic point or optimized endpoint
conditions.per_new_eta: original J initialization,then exactly two successive same-array Newton-CG refinements
conditions.purpose: PR-only at most ONE qualified U update;numerical pilot,NOT simultaneous convergence or performance comparison

algorithm.inner: UNCHANGED same-array Newton-CG,maxiter1000/xtol1e-12;original J initialization plus exactly2 successive refinements at each new eta
algorithm.admission: UNCHANGED independent final J1e-5+margin,latest-pair physical/chart U-shift1e-6,PR rank/nullspace/tail injectivity,correctness and nonincrease
algorithm.initial: fresh evaluation of original eta0;initial unqualified,no nonzero direction,nonpositive F0,or both-first-order-MET => no trial/explicit STOP
algorithm.direction: d=-g0 from admitted original eta0;s=g0 dot d is a reported candidate slope,NOT a certified true reduced derivative
algorithm.scale: alpha_scale=F0/(-s);alpha=alpha_scale*(1/8);one positive trial eta0+alpha*d;no saved diagnostic eta/J adoption,negative probes,halving or adaptive alternatives
algorithm.acceptance: provisional only if admitted trial and Ftrial+comparison_scale<=F0+c1*alpha*s AND Ftrial+comparison_scale<F0;c1=1e-4;unknown inner bias is not bounded by comparison_scale
algorithm.value_scale: reuse local_direction.value_profile/comparison_scale:maximum of original value_atol+rtol*maxabsF,observed latest-refinement value changes,same-array extended/binary64 and independent AD value differences
algorithm.independent_terminal: only after provisional pass,exactly1 existing stable.state re-evaluation at identical trial J/U/eta with original base_U;save physical and chart gradients,binary64 observations,J/U gates,raw prior flags separately;NO J resolve/refinement
algorithm.independent_checks: same-array value/chart-gradient compare uses original allowances;orthogonality and all inherited checks remain;correctness mismatch=>partial FAIL/STOP;independent J NOT_MET=>unqualified/no update;U first-order NOT_MET is recorded independently and does not prevent a descent-step acceptance
algorithm.commit_acceptance: only after independent terminal J MET and consistency PASS;accept at most1 trial;no further direction,trial,optimizer or BFGS call
algorithm.no_acceptance: initial unqualified or single-trial qualification failure/Armijo/value-scale failure/post J unqualified => terminal remains original-U refined initial;save rejected trial separately;no fallback or retry
algorithm.export: diagnostic_terminal.npz contains accepted trial J/U only ifaccepted_U_updates=1,otherwise initial diagnostic;never claim DF budget qualified without measurement

numerical_allowances.rank_rule: existing head rank LD*d-(LD-1),only U-independent universal head gauges;extra/ambiguous null refused;tail injectivity;no pseudoinverse/drop/ridge

value_resolution.comparison_scale: max(registered scale,known observed scales for both compared points);all same scalar objective units;NOT a rigorous bound
value_resolution.forward_label: not a new FD experiment;strict scale-covered Armijo comparison is a numerical engineering acceptance rule,NOT certified descent
value_resolution.FD_sensitivity_scale: comparison_scale(Fplus,Fminus)/(2*h);no truncation or unknown-inner bias bound is asserted
value_resolution.forbid: Do not set unknown error to0 or use FD agreement alone as true gradient qualification

calls.small_step_driver: 1,original eta0 and exactly1 candidate U trial;zero external outer optimizer
calls.inner_J_solve: <=6,3 per distinct eta;raw x0/x/J/z/jac/W,pre-step semantics,VG/Hessian diagnostics included
calls.precision_state: <=4,2 per distinct eta;existing independent J/U and chart/physical consistency
calls.independent_terminal_assessment: <=1,only provisionally accepted trial;one new existing stable.state evaluation plus comparisons;NO further J solves
calls.export: 1,already-computed terminal J/U and JSON only;no physical norm
